scope: Union B E stationary actions only, candidate v11; limited preview source acceptance
verdict: PASS for a narrowly bounded opt-in visual preview with recorded scale and occlusion limits
inspectedCells: TR right-shoulder aim/fire without baked discharge

appearance.identity: Short brown hair, moustache/chin hair, navy cap and B body proportions are coherent across these four E profiles and recognizable against the accepted B references; exact facial or skeletal identity is not certified.
appearance.uniform: All four retain short navy coat, pale blue trousers, brown boots, light cross straps and brass cap/belt/button details.
appearance.backpack: All four retain the dark backpack and rolled gray blanket in the same body-relative rear location.
appearance.rightPouch: The near anatomical-right dark hip pouch remains present in all four cells.
appearance.leftCanteen: A narrow silver canteen edge is visible behind the near pouch/rear hip in all four. This is plausible far-side left-canteen occlusion in the fixed E camera; its concealed attachment cannot be fully verified. There is no large near-side canteen replacing the pouch as in rejected march attempt 1.

bearingAndGrip.camera: Native generated east profile; no mirrored or raster-transformed source was used in this review.
bearingAndGrip.ready: Diagonal upright rifle held at fore-end and stock with a visible bayonet and plausible two-hand attachment.
bearingAndGrip.fire: Rifle points to image right with nearly horizontal barrel, stock against the visible shoulder, rear hand at trigger/stock and forward hand under fore-end. No visible baked flash or smoke.
bearingAndGrip.load: Upright grounded rifle, one lower supporting hand and one hand at the upper loading region.
bearingAndGrip.ram: Same upright rifle with raised insertion hand and a separate narrow rod; body/head lean differs naturally from BL.
bearingAndGrip.limits: Visual plausibility only; exact cheek/stock contact, finger mechanics, loading choreography and historical drill remain uncertified.

measurementContract.coordinateSpace: Native per-cell pixels, x/y from each 627x627 cell top-left; cell order TL/TR/BL/BR.
measurementContract.rootMeaning: Estimated pelvis-centered horizontal registration projected to a shared visible boot-ground row. Concealed anatomical pelvis and physical ground cannot be recovered exactly from a generated 2D source.
measurementContract.capMethod: Fresh alpha>=64 bounds in independently selected cap-only regions; BR cap region excludes raised arm.
measurementContract.commonReferenceChoice: One uniform body reference and one whole-source scale for all stationary frames; reference includes a measured pose variation and does not normalize each cap-to-ground span.
measurementContract.sizeLimit: BL load is visibly taller than TL ready by 26px/6.22%; fire leans slightly and BR head/arm pose changes. Preserve this observed variation explicitly. Do not silently apply per-frame scaling.
measurementContract.firingBarrelMouthConfidence: Moderate: measured terminal upper tube edge, distinguishable from the lower socket bayonet continuing to x598; an exposed circular bore is not visible.
measurementContract.firingTubeTerminalAlphaEvidence: At local y235..243 upper tube alpha>=64 ends at x491..493; the bayonet continues below y244 to the right.

nativePixelEvidence.paddingAssessment: All cells exceed 24px structural floor, but top row misses the requested 32px generation goal by 3px. No clipping is visible.

limits: This verdict applies only to the exact SHA and four stationary E cells reviewed.
The source has no walk cycle, turn coverage, runtime renderer proof or completed live-playthrough proof.
Far-side canteen attachment and parts of the pelvis are occluded.
A single whole-source reference preserves measured body-height variation; exact physical body scale is not certified.
Production/default promotion and full Union B family completion are outside this review.
